purpose: Turn the complete story world into a region-by-region build campaign while keeping runtime implementation serialized through the P1C01 benchmark.
global_rules: DEC-038 applies to every region: locked canon beats + playable safe windows + bounded set pieces + persistent world-state consequences + return to player control.
Resources serve canon and chapter identity; they never redefine story chronology.
Exactly one runtime-changing PR at a time.
All later-region work before P1C01 Gate 6/7 is asset/authoring/design/warehouse preparation only.
No region is called accepted from source registration, staging, compile, or headless checks alone.

world_streaming.notes: Define chunk/level ownership and memory budgets before broad runtime integration.

save_load.notes: Must preserve route/chapter/world-state continuity as new regions integrate.

living_world.notes: LivingWorldDirector + context subsystems remain decoupled; use pooling and bounded simulation.

weather_wind.notes: Shared visual/audio weather state only after visual wind path is engine-green.

accessibility.notes: Subtitle/readability/input/accessibility review remains whole-game acceptance work.

localization.notes: English audio + professional Arabic localization through FText/String Tables/RTL.

Then promote next region/chapter runtime build from its prepared world packet
next_preproduction_actions: Create per-region asset candidate packets from the 142-source registry.
Create canon-beat and playable-safe-window maps per chapter.
Keep warehouse staging and authored asset preparation running while runtime PR #80 validates.
